# Fábio Paulo — Software Engineer & MSc Researcher

> Computer Engineer and MSc in Informatics from the Polytechnic University of Bragança (IPB). Specializing in React, TypeScript, Kotlin, Python, and applied Deep Learning for real-time Web3D gesture manipulation.

## Core Competencies & Tech Stack
- **Frontend & Web:** TypeScript, React, Vite, Angular, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Three.js / Web3D.
- **Backend & APIs:** Python (Flask), Kotlin (Ktor), Node.js, REST APIs.
- **Mobile Development:** Kotlin, Android SDK, Jetpack Compose.
- **Artificial Intelligence & Deep Learning:** MediaPipe, LSTM / GRU, Computer Vision, real-time gesture tracking and 3D rendering optimization.
- **DevOps & Tooling:** Docker, Git, Linux, GitHub Actions.

## Academic & Research Background
